content: The encoder is composed of a stack of INLINEFORM0 identical layers. Each layer has two sub-layers: multi-head self-attention mechanism and position-wise fully connected feed-forward network. Similarly, the decoder is also composed of a stack of INLINEFORM1 identical layers. In addition to the two sub-layers in each encoder layer, the decoder contains a third sub-layer which performs multi-head attention over the output of the encoder stack (see more details in BIBREF4 ).
